name: Monk Laboratory
summary: Monk Laboratory is a free multiplayer VR game where you play as a monkey exploring using only your arms to move. Climb, swing, and launch yourself through an open playground built for full-body locomotion. With built-in voice chat, you can talk and interact with other players in real time, making every session a fun and social experience. Whether you're racing across obstacles, discovering secret rooms, or just hanging out, Monk Laboratory offers immersive, physics-based gameplay designed to keep you moving
